object_description: two accommodation volumes linked by a lower base
design_condition: The set-back, angled volumes follow the slope through two reference levels and frame a generous southern courtyard while relating selectively to the castle park, village and existing walls.

positive.statement: The two accommodation volumes and lower base create a harmonious informal whole on the historic site.

position.target: two accommodation volumes and lower base
position.rationale: Paired angled volumes and connecting base are clearly visible across plan and elevations.

positive.statement: The building manages the natural slope internally by creating two equivalent reference levels.

position.rationale: Stepped multi-level organization is evident in elevations, with horizontal placement approximated from the plan.

positive.statement: The exterior extensions establish a privileged relationship with the village and offer residents safe enjoyment of the courtyard.

position.rationale: Southern open space and projecting accommodation edges are identifiable in the top view and south elevation.

positive.statement: The accommodation typology is very compact and rational.

position.rationale: The compact paired footprint and simple stacked volumes are visible across the model views.

positive.statement: The project shows great accuracy in considering the site, heritage and landscape qualities.

position.rationale: The southern and western building edges provide the closest sampled approximation to the referenced site context.

positive.statement: The overall cost benefits from the compactness and simplicity of the volumes.

position.rationale: Simple compact massing is directly represented by the two restrained volumes and lower connector.

negative.statement: The ground-floor organization is too schematic and should be reorganized for optimal functioning.

position.rationale: Ground level is constrained by the lowest elevation rows and the corresponding plan footprint.

negative.statement: Delivery to the kitchen and logistical flows inside and between the buildings need clarification.

position.rationale: Interior logistics are not distinguishable, so the east accommodation base is used as a constrained surface anchor.

negative.statement: The path toward the east building passes directly in front of rooms and modifies the status of the terrace.

position.rationale: The eastern volume and adjacent approach zone are localized from the plan and east-facing extent.

negative.statement: The new constructions pay little attention to existing developments and establish insufficient dialogue with them.

position.rationale: Existing context is absent from the sample; the outer building edge provides a directional approximation.

negative.statement: The oversized mineral courtyard damages the landscape and heritage qualities of the privileged southern setting.

position.rationale: The generous southern open area is clearly identifiable immediately below the accommodation volumes.

negative.statement: The old garden gate appears as a vestige without functionality or connection to the surrounding complex.

position.rationale: The gate is not individually visible; a low western-southern site-edge anchor is assigned.

negative.statement: The western corner forms a spur toward the old garden wall and contradicts the historically harmonious atmosphere.

position.rationale: The western projecting corner is visible in plan and corresponds to the lower western elevation extent.

negative.statement: The hedged garden rooms introduce an undesirable break with the character of the existing open park.

position.rationale: Garden subdivisions are not resolved; the southern open-space region is the nearest plausible surface location.

negative.statement: The park is closed and the relationship between the village and park is not promoted from outside.

position.rationale: The exterior park relationship is unrepresented, approximated along the southern outward-facing edge.

negative.statement: The project does not offer adequate solar protection for the generous glazed surfaces.

position.rationale: Glazing and shading devices are unresolved; the southern-facing accommodation facade is used as the constrained anchor.

negative.statement: The buried volume has a strong impact on earth movements.

position.rationale: The buried portion is not separately visible; the lower central footprint is the plausible excavation location.

negative.statement: The accommodation area is slightly above target, although optimization remains possible.

position.rationale: Accommodation massing and extent are directly represented by the paired building volumes.
